title: A survey of large language models for healthcare: from data, technology, and applications to accountability and ethics

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying existing literature on algorithmic fairness and underdiagnosis tendencies for female patients in medical imaging datasets (e.g., chest X-rays), and reviewing mitigation techniques such as RLHF, importance weighting, and resampling.

Surveying existing literature on underrepresentation and underdiagnosis biases affecting Black and Hispanic patients in healthcare datasets, and evaluating the impact of demographic distribution in pre-training corpora.

Surveying literature on healthcare disparities affecting marginalized communities based on socioeconomic status (e.g., patients covered by Medicaid) and evaluating equitable access to AI medical services.
Evaluating the performance disparities of LLMs across different input languages and discussing the need for multilingual support to bridge the global digital divide in healthcare AI.
